name: narrow-home-layout
query: Set up a private marketing workspace for our upcoming planner launch, with campaign briefs, drafts, and brand resources. Make the next action easy to find.

context.conversation: The launch video is blocked until we record the product walkthrough. Use this as the immediate next action.

success_criteria: Keeps navigation labels compact and places the sentence-length next action above columns or in the wide working area.
Uses MCP for all writes; UI is used only for inspection. Reports unavailable page-width controls.
Preserves campaign, draft, and brand-resource navigation and usable working views.
Checks rendered wrapping when inspection is available and reports the actual viewport tested.
